item.title: Seahawks Running Back Kenneth Walker III Is Named MVP of Super Bowl LX
item.description: After Seattle defeated the Patriots 29–13 on Sunday, running back Kenneth Walker III of the Seahawks was named the MVP of Super Bowl LX. Walker finished a postseason run in which he carried for 309 yards and four touchdowns across three games with 131 yards and an average of 5.2 yards per carry. item.title: Behind The Build: Theo Murdaugh & Run It Up Dallas Drive Economic Opportunity
